_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 36: 3-5 November 2025. Completes November 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says everybody has the same twenty four hour day and seven day week and he has to make money like anyone else, but that it comes down to priorities, comparing it to the man who goes to the gym twice a day and looks the part.
mentions.quote: EVERYBODY HAS a 24-hour day and a 7-day work week
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an answer to people asking how he finds the time.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that they pass the test, says they attract to deflect, and repeats that it is not about him but all about Jesus and all glory goes to Jesus.
mentions.quote: We attract to deflect. It's not about me
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement of intent about attention.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts the Oklahoma land run, saying it was sad because the land came from the Indians, and that the Sooners were those who went out and took land before the run started.
mentions.quote: the Sooners were the ones that went out and got the land
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: recounted history, broadly accurate.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the price fifty thousand dollars, and asks whether anyone remembers that on October the 19th he was caught up in the spirit and shown a list of names, seeing four entities being paid major money.
mentions.quote: I saw four entities being paid major money
mentions.falsify_match: Four entities revealed to have received large payments.
mentions.falsify_miss: None revealed. Neither the entities nor what the fifty thousand refers to are stated.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told to watch Pope Leo concerning the Olympics and to watch the timeframe going into the next three months to February the 3rd of 2026, which he says is when the Olympics start, calling it a window and noting today is exactly three months out.
mentions.quote: Watch Pope Leo concerning the Olympic
mentions.falsify_match: Something involving the pope around the Winter Olympics.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. The Milan Cortina games open on 6 February, not the 3rd, so the date he builds the window on is wrong.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not focus on the devil or on what he is doing because he is a loser, that this is almost over and they are wrapping it up, that Jesus Christ is coming, and that he wants listeners to have their eyes more open.
mentions.quote: This is almost over. We're wrapping this thing up
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: imminence with no date, said continuously since the channel began.

mentions.claim_text: He says it may be three years or it may be tomorrow and he does not know, but that in his spirit he believes there is a major revival and a major harvest of souls coming, with blind eyes and deaf ears opened and limbs restored.
mentions.quote: It may be three years. It may be tomorrow. I don't know
mentions.falsify_match: A documented revival with verified healings.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He explicitly refuses to date it, which is the honest version of the same claim he dates elsewhere.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will start to see things they never thought they would see, that the birthing labour pains are increasing, that Jesus Christ is coming and there will be a major harvest of souls and a glorious church without spot or wrinkle.
mentions.quote: The birthing as labor pains, they're increasing
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: increasing labour pains describe any period of news.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying that if they do not start praying and interceding now they will lose the midterm and cannot wait until this time next year to start, and says he saw Oklahoma being divided.
mentions.quote: if you don't start interceding now, you'll lose midterm
mentions.falsify_match: Republicans lose the midterms, which he would read as insufficient prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: They win, read as prayer answered. The conditional makes both outcomes confirmations.

mentions.claim_text: He anticipates the objection that he is quoting tribulation, agrees, but says something is different and changing and that they know the pressure, and that listeners will start to see things they never thought they would see.
mentions.quote: you're going to start to see things you never thought you would see
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no threshold is given for what counts as never thought you would see.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told he has been given this time, notes that most people think the midterms are just a year away and that it is a year away tomorrow, and says what the Lord showed him was a stalemate government.
mentions.quote: what the Lord showed me was is a stalemate government
mentions.falsify_match: A divided Congress after the 2026 midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unified control either way. This sits against red-wave-2026, told by the same man in the same period.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw people not wanting to secede from the United States but wanting their own country and saying they will not go this way, saw people very upset with Gavin, and saw a red wave trying to come over California.
mentions.quote: I saw a red wave trying to come over California
mentions.falsify_match: A Republican shift in California and visible secession sentiment.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Trying to come over is doing a lot of work: it allows a shift that does not arrive.

mentions.claim_text: He opens by greeting the audience, notes it is late at night rather than morning, and says he came on to pray with them before they go to bed.
mentions.quote: I just wanted to come on and pray with you all a little bit tonight
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a greeting.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that they are believing God so big and are so pregnant spiritually that they have spiritual stretch marks, and that it is time to believe God for exceedingly abundantly above all they dare ask or think.
mentions.quote: you're so pregnant spiritually that you have spiritual stretch marks
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He reads emails warning him to be careful because the devil will hear him and he does not want to provoke a principality, and answers that he is not out there sticking his finger in a principality's eye.
mentions.quote: The devil's going to hear you. You don't want to provoke a principality
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an objection from his own audience and his answer to it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were even told the day, to watch from the 23rd of September on because September would be a month to remember that nobody will forget, and points to Charlie Kirk going home as the fulfilment.
mentions.quote: Watch from the 23rd on of September. September will be a month to remember
mentions.falsify_match: A memorable September event on or after the 23rd.
mentions.falsify_miss: The event he offers as the fulfilment, the Charlie Kirk killing, happened on 10 September, thirteen days before the window he says he was given.

mentions.claim_text: He rejects the idea that they will always be poor backwards people living off the land, declaring that he is more than a conqueror, has more than enough and that his bank account overflows, and that he is not moved by what he sees.
mentions.quote: I'm more than a conqueror. I have more than enough
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is calling-things-that-be-not applied to money.

mentions.claim_text: He says he talked too long and wanted to stir them up before praying so that they know they have authority, and that if the Lord shows him more about these doors that is good and if not he will show him something else.
mentions.quote: stir you up a little bit before we pray that you have authority
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, but the shrug about whether more comes is worth having: the sight is not guaranteed to arrive.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the Olympics, the Winter Olympics, in the next three months, then counts November, December, January and February and corrects himself to four months.
mentions.quote: I see the Winter Olympics in the next 3 months
mentions.falsify_match: Something notable at the Winter Olympics.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. Seeing the Olympics carries no content beyond the fact that they are scheduled.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks about heaven and says Jesus is coming soon and that they will spend eternity with the father, then leads a well known hymn of surrender.
mentions.quote: Jesus is coming soon
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: soon with no date.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether it is coming this December 31st, says he is not saying that and that he sees in part and hears in part, but that it is something to pray about seriously, and prays over New York and Times Square for the New Year's Eve celebration.
mentions.quote: I'm not saying that. I see in part, I hear in part
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at the Times Square New Year's Eve celebration.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He hedges it explicitly to a prayer target rather than a prediction, which is the in-part clause doing its usual work.
